authority: A single-character grouping-separator, distinct from every other picture property: a well-formed decimal format under XPath 3.1 F&O 4.7.1, and the same shape as F&O 4.7.2's own example, "The expression format-number(1234.5678, '#ʹ##0·00', 'ch') returns \"1ʹ234·57\"". F&O 4.7.4 then makes the grouping regular at G=3 and extrapolates it to the seven-digit number.
